description: Thai precast concrete property fence: two slotted H-section concrete posts with stacked horizontal concrete plank slabs dropped between them, painted white.

image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Precast concrete fence panel of two square slotted concrete posts with a row of horizontal concrete plank slabs stacked between them in the slots, a moulded cap on each post, the whole panel painted white Materials: White paint grey with dirt and black algae streaks at the slab joints, exposed grey concrete chips at the corners, green moss along the bottom slab.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Fully synthetic. No third-party scanned or scraped geometry.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.92. 252/4,000 triangles, 2/4 draw calls, 2/3 materials, 2/6 unique geometries, two canvases at 1.7 MB, factory ~110 ms.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 2.46 x 2.00 x 0.26 m (one post per tile, slabs 0.06 m past the edge into the next tile's slot); the cap re-proportioned to the plate's plinth-and-low-pyramid (0.26 square, 0.07 thick, 0.04 pyramid) in place of the first build's spike. Band table vs the proxy: mean |delta width| 0.029, |delta depth| 0.002 of height.
featureReviews.notes: Cap overhang is the depth residual.

featureReviews.evidence: Seven chamfered courses from 0.02 to 1.80 m with a shadow joint at each, recessed 0.03 m behind the post faces, and now a black algae band under every joint on the canvas (the plate reads luma 20-60 in 0.05-0.07 m bands under each course, heaviest at the post end): a soft under-joint gradient whose strength varies along the bay plus narrow irregular drips, three times denser over tile u 0.48..0.72, the post end.

Moss rebuilt as a CARPET: 19,186 green plate pixels measure mean [61,68,23] in rows 640-920 with a top edge climbing from 0.55 to 0.8 m across the bay; the canvas now lays a per-column moss wash under 26,000 fine tufts (a fifth of them lime tips) whose density is a ragged sine-plus-random-walk boundary in the bottom 0.32 of the 2 m tile, over a grey-green dirt wash, with five ragged paint chips to bare grey. The first build's seventy soft clusters read as mottled dots.
featureReviews.notes: The mat renders a touch paler and yellower than the plate's olive core.

name: Precast Concrete Fence Panel
nameTh: รั้วคอนกรีตสำเร็จรูป
notes: The standard house and land-plot boundary fence across Thailand, sold by the panel and stacked in the post slots, which is why the horizontal joints are the identity. Tiles post to post. Placement overridden to floor. Not breakable: the slabs are stacked but a game will not pull them out. One post per tile: the post is on the -X end and the bay runs to the +X edge, so tiles chain along X with no doubled post at a joint.
